references.text: The same purity law regarding washing clothes, bathing in water, and being unclean until evening applies to anyone who touches the bed of a man with a discharge.
A corresponding purity rule for anyone who touches the body of someone with a discharge: they must wash their clothes, bathe, and remain unclean until evening.
Continuation of the same topic concerning uncleanness from touching a woman's bed or any object she has sat on.
General rule that whoever carries carcasses of unclean animals must wash their clothes and remains unclean until evening - following the same pattern for cleansing.
Similar purity law about washing clothes, bathing in water, and being unclean until evening.
Rule to wash clothes and remain unclean until evening after touching unclean things.
Purity law with the same pattern: washing clothes and uncleanness until evening upon touching unclean things.
